title: Timeline & checklist
summary: The cycle month by month, with a checklist that saves your progress.

blocks.md: UK recruiting runs a year ahead. Spring weeks open in August–September of first year and close by November; summer analyst applications open in August of second year and many close by October, with rolling review. Treat 1 September as the start of the season, whatever year you are in.

items.label: One-page CV in the four-section format, reviewed by two people
Target list: 10 banks × the programme you are eligible for, with deadlines in a calendar
Networking list of 30 names, first 10 messages sent
Accounting and EqV vs EV lessons completed (the free topics)
Own three-statement model of one UK company started
Applications submitted in the first two weeks of each window (rolling review)
Practised numerical / situational tests for each bank's provider
Five networking calls completed, thank-yous sent
Valuation and DCF canonical answers memorised; 3 timed drills passed
Why banking / why this bank / why you — written and said aloud under 90 seconds
Two full mocks completed with scores above 7/10
Firm question bank read for every interview booked
One market story and one deal ready to discuss, refreshed weekly
Told every contact you spoke to which stage you reached
Off-cycle and boutique applications live if no summer offer by February
Big Four TS / valuations applications considered as a parallel route
Written a one-page retro of every rejection: stage, reason if known, fix
